svg.title: How DNS finds a website
svg.desc: How DNS finds a website. You → Browser: types example.com. Browser → Resolver: where is it?. Resolver ↔ Root server: try .com. Resolver ↔ .com server: try ns1. Resolver ↔ example.com name server: 93.184.216.34. Note on Resolver: remembers the answer for next time (TTL).
